name: Aztec calendar hide
label: Hides
lead: Round reptile hide with an Aztec calendar relief on its flat top and a side entrance - a themed shelter and platform in one.

description.html: This hide is shaped like a low cylinder, like a stone block from an ancient temple. The flat top features a detailed Aztec calendar relief with rays in terracotta color, and the sides are decorated with carved patterns. On one side there is an arched entrance into the dark interior.

An enclosed space with one entrance gives your animal a sense of security: it is protected from above and from the sides while keeping an eye on the exit. The flat top can also serve as a resting or basking platform if you place the hide under a lamp.
It pairs nicely with our dish with Aztec patterns, for a terrarium styled as jungle or desert ruins.

It is good to have at least two hides in a terrarium, one on the warm side and one on the cool side, so your animal does not have to choose between security and the right temperature. Place the hide directly on the terrarium floor and fill the substrate around it, so your animal cannot dig underneath and the hide cannot collapse. Wash it with warm water once a week.
